title: AI Usage Policy for Businesses: A 5-Step Framework for 2026
excerpt: 78% of AI users bring their own tools to work, yet only 40% of employees have AI guidance. Build a short AI usage policy in five steps.
metadesc: Your team already uses AI. Build an AI usage policy in 5 steps: tool audit, data rules, human review, an AI lead and a simple template. With 2026 data.
featured_alt: AI usage policy for businesses featured image showing workplace AI statistics on bring your own AI, hidden AI use and policy coverage

alts.INFO_1: Infographic of workplace AI statistics: 78% of AI users bring their own tools, 58% of employees use AI, 57% hide it, 66% skip accuracy checks, 40% have a policy
alts.INFO_2: Infographic of a five-step framework to build an AI usage policy: audit tools, sort into buckets, set data rules, assign human owners, name an AI lead and review
